experiment: tile BFS (ch07: 32x32 tiles closed in registers, rounds of tiles) with its rounds-kernel switches (one_sync, fused_pack, skip_full, fused_paint) timed as an ablation against the old default (two grid.sync per round, separate pack and paint), vs ch03's conn4 / conn8 / warp-coop BFS kernels (instrumented and bare, several grids) and ch06's run-table CCL, one interleaved round-robin per scene, CUDA-event timings on every side

ch06_runs.run_capacity: max(8192, n/16, runs in the scene)

timing_note: ch07 *_ms = pack + init + rounds + paint (first event to last; with fused_pack the pack interval is empty and the RGB is read inside rounds, with fused_paint so is paint). ch03 *_ms = its one kernel launch; its device reset is off the clock and timed separately (ch03_reset_ms). ch06_runs *_ms = pack + count + scan + emit + merge + flatten + paint, rgb contract. Every run: image restored from a device copy, 96 MB L2 flush read, GPU sleep kernel queued ahead so host launch overhead is excluded. ch07_w4_e2e_ms = pageable H2D + pipeline + D2H of the painted image (perf_counter, reused buffers). njit8_ms = the @njit oracle end to end (allocations, depth map, no paint), timed after all GPU scenes.
